meta.name: onecli-gateway
meta.description: OneCLI Gateway: transparent HTTPS proxy that injects stored credentials into outbound calls. You MUST use this skill when the user asks you to read emails, check calendar, access GitHub repos, create issues, check Stripe payments, or interact with ANY external service or API. Do NOT use browser extensions or OAuth CLI tools. Make HTTP requests directly; the gateway injects credentials automatically.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 自动为外部API请求注入凭证，无需手动认证
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要调用多个外部API并处理认证
copy.tagline_en: Automatically inject credentials into external API requests
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently call multiple external APIs and handle authentication

howto.what: Claude 会直接向外部 API 发 HTTP 请求,由网关在代理层自动注入已存凭据,它本身看不到也无需处理凭据值。若服务未连接,请求会返回错误信息和一条连接链接。
howto.when: 当你让它读邮件、查日历、访问 GitHub 等外部服务或 API 时,它就会接管并直接发请求,而不是改用浏览器或 OAuth 工具。

say.text: 帮我读一下 Gmail 最近的 5 封邮件
say.note: 直接调 Gmail API,凭据由网关注入

say.text: 列出我 GitHub 上的仓库
say.note: 访问 api.github.com,不用你提供 token

say.text: 查一下 Stripe 最近 5 笔支付
say.note: 未连接时会返回一条连接链接

howto.what_en: Claude sends HTTP requests straight to external APIs; the gateway injects stored credentials at the proxy layer, so it never sees or handles them. If a service isn't connected, the error returns a connect link.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask it to read email, check calendar, access GitHub, or work with any external service or API.

say_en.text: Read my 5 most recent Gmail messages
say_en.note: Calls the Gmail API; the gateway injects credentials
Returns a connect link if Stripe isn't connected
